topography.project_purpose: Anchor BTC. Structurally: 133 project-authored contract(s) across 11 chain(s); 16 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 12 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, accesscontrolupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
